dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: Welcome, welcome to Podvorye Restaurant. If you should like anything, don't hesitate to speak to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me take a look at the menu...

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: Of course! Please. Anytime you're ready to order, just come to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, Podvorye, the "homestead." How stead-y has this homey house been going?

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: Oh, very! Consider, after all, the employees here are all long-lived fae... My, even I cannot say how long this place has been trucking along.

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: If you harbor any concerns that you might not be tasting authentic flavors, worry not! Our current boss... has been head chef here for a very, very long time now.

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: Why, when he took up the mantle, I was just a furball rolling around the snowy plains.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you take reservations around here?

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: Not by our house rules, no. But if you really, really need it, you can tell me in advance...

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: You see, there will sometimes be tables we've forgotten to assign guests to, which can then have a most fortuitous encounter with you. A joyous arrangement for all, I say.

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: Every dish here comes highly recommended! Anything that has stood the test of time and stayed on the menu has more than earned its spot there.

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: Whether you like it or not depends on your preferences, and my suggestion to that end is... try more dishes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm. I don't need anything right now...

dialogues.speaker: Buturlina
dialogues.text: Then we await your next visit, dear customer.
